Import libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggthemes)
library(Metrics)
library(broom.mixed)
library(confintr)
library(colf)
library(optimx)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggeffects)
source(here("helper/run_k_fold.R"))
options(dplyr.summarise.inform=F)


```

helper function
```{r}
renaming <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
  group_by(param_id, trial_type) %>%
  filter(all(2:10 %in% trial_number)) %>% # only keep parameters for which all fam durations have been computed
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(test_type = trial_type) %>%
  mutate(fam_duration = trial_number - 1,
         test_type = case_when(test_type == 'background' ~ 'fam', test_type == 'deviant' ~ 'nov')) 
  return(df)
}


```

# Load data and model sims
```{r}
infant_data = read_csv(here('infants/data/infant_exposure_duration.csv')) %>% filter(fam_or_test == 'test', !exclude)

# load data
aligned_data = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_aligned_eig.csv')) 
resnet50_data = read_csv(here('simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_eig.csv')) 

# remove the trial 0 of novel
aligned_data = aligned_data %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
resnet50_data = resnet50_data %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
```

# Sanity check
```{r}

resnet50_data  %>% ggplot(aes(x = trial_number, y = mean_sample, color = test_type)) +
 stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot") + ggtitle('EIG scaled')


```


# Crossvalidation 
```{r}
infant_data = infant_data %>% mutate(subj_id = paste0(experiment, subject_num))

infant_kfold_aligned_eig <- lapply(
  unique(aligned_data$param_id), 
  function(id){
    run_subject_wise_crossvalidation(p_id = id, 
               raw_d = infant_data, 
               sd = aligned_data)
  }
) %>% 
  bind_rows()

infant_kfold_resnet50_eig <- lapply(
  unique(aligned_data$param_id), 
  function(id){
    run_subject_wise_crossvalidation(p_id = id, 
               raw_d = infant_data, 
               sd = resnet50)
  }
) %>% 
  bind_rows()


saveRDS(infant_kfold_aligned_eig, here("cached_data/infant_kfold_aligned_eig.Rds"))
saveRDS(infant_kfold_resnet50_eig, here("cached_data/infant_kfold_resnet50_eig.Rds"))

```

# Show top param and cross validation

```{r}

full_k_fold_res %>% ggplot(aes(x = mean_rsquared)) + geom_histogram() + theme_minimal()

top_corr = full_k_fold_res %>% arrange(desc(mean_rsquared)) %>% head(1) %>% pull(param_id)

top_sim_result = combined_df %>% filter(param_id == top_corr) 

plot_df = top_sim_result %>% dplyr::rename(`Infant behavior` = LT, `RANCH (infants)` = scaled_samples) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("RANCH (infants)", "Infant behavior"), names_to = "value_type", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(value_type = factor(value_type, levels = c("Infant behavior", "RANCH (infants)")),
        test_type = ifelse(test_type == 'nov', 'Novel', 'Familiar')) 

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = fam_duration, y = value, color = test_type, group = test_type)) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", size = 2) +  geom_point(size = 3)  + ylab('Looking time (s)') + xlab('fam duration') +  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,1,2,3,4,6,8,9)) + xlab('Exposure duration') + labs(color = 'Test type') + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 25)) + facet_grid(~value_type) + theme_classic(30) + scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red"))


```
